title: Turned into disappointment and option toggling
summary: This topic mixes clear disappointment about ownership or design issues with several ambiguous uses of "turned" about restarting, accidental activation, a faulty sensor, or making a feature optional.

negative.summary: Negative feedback describes a first purchase becoming a major disappointment and serious design choices that block rear visibility and create safety concerns.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention turning the vehicle off and on, accidental activation, a faulty sensor, and a request for an on-off option without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects linked mainly by the word "turned," so it is not a coherent single issue.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined and very short, which limits confident interpretation beyond the quoted text.
Examples are insufficient to determine whether the sensor mention or restart behavior reflects a broader customer concern.
